The patch should be formatted as the rest of the file.

Why choose a btree here? The list is created linearly, so the advantage of faster inserts does not exist, does it? Wouldn't a binary search on an array lead to the same performance with only a fractional overhead. You do not need to balance the tree, etc.

I didn't know about `g_array_binary_search`, so I used a binary tree. I added another commit to restore the array, so that they can be squashed for merge.

> The patch should be formatted as the rest of the file.

What do you mean with this?
